instruction: Center-align the title of the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to add page numbers to footers. Opened Insert menu, navigated to Header and Footer submenu, but got stuck in loops between footer deletion dialogs and menu navigation for 50 turns without successfully inserting page numbers.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open LibreOffice Writer menus (Insert, Format), navigate document pages, interact with dialog boxes, access Header and Footer submenu
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to complete the multi-step footer+page number insertion workflow. Got confused by footer deletion dialog, repeatedly toggled footer on/off without inserting page number field. Ran out of turns.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single formatting operation (center-align title) which requires fewer steps than footer manipulation. Model demonstrated ability to use formatting toolbar.
metadata.explanation: Task asks to center the first heading. Getter reads docx and extracts first paragraph alignment. Metric checks if alignment equals 'center'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the first paragraph's alignment from the docx file using python-docx, which is a reasonable proxy for the document title.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('expected_alignment') without wrapping in 'rules' key.
Expected value 'center' correctly matches the instruction requirement to center-align the title.
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring state freshness.
Getter handles edge cases: None alignment mapped to 'left', empty document, and file not found.
Complete coverage: instruction has a single requirement (center-align title) and evaluator checks exactly that.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The getter assumes the title is doc.paragraphs[0]. If the document has empty paragraphs before the actual title, this could read the wrong paragraph. Consider iterating to find the first non-empty paragraph or the first heading-styled paragraph for more robustness.
